# Task: fix the failing consumer test on YOUR PR #6997 (in-PR, before merge)

You are agy. PR #6997 (reaper unpushed-head guard) breaks
`tests/review/test_temp_lifecycle.py::test_terminal_task_reaped_immediately` on CI shard 1 —
a consumer of reap semantics you did not run locally (your targeted set was
test_reap_worktrees + test_fleet_post_task_reap only).

## Steps
1. In your worktree (.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6996-reaper-guard, branch
   agy/infra-6996-reaper-guard): read the failing test's INTENT first. Decide at the right
   layer:
   - If review-temp worktrees hold only checkouts of already-pushed SHAs, the new
     reachable-from-origin guard should PASS for them and the test failure means your guard
     mis-evaluates that case (e.g. detached HEAD, shallow/sparse temp, fetchless clone) —
     fix the guard.
   - If the test fabricates a local-only commit in a terminal temp, the test now describes
     the OLD unsafe semantics — update the test to the new contract (pushed → reap,
     unpushed → skip) and say so in the commit message.
2. Run the FULL consumer surface this time:
   `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/review/test_temp_lifecycle.py
   tests/orchestration/test_reap_worktrees.py tests/test_fleet_post_task_reap.py -q`
   plus `ugrep -l "reap" tests/ | xargs .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` if it adds files.
   Quote output.
3. ruff on touched files. Push to the SAME branch. NO auto-merge.

### Step 1 Analysis & Branch Decision

**Branch 2 Applied (Updating Test to New Contract: Pushed → Reap, Unpushed → Skip)**:
- In [`tests/review/test_temp_lifecycle.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6996-reaper-guard/tests/review/test_temp_lifecycle.py), `test_terminal_task_reaped_immediately` and `test_terminal_task_reaped_with_none_active_ids` were synthetic unit tests of [`_qualifying_reason`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6996-reaper-guard/scripts/orchestration/reap_worktrees.py#L645) targeting mock worktree dirs.
- They mocked `_is_ancestor_of_origin_main=False` to assert the **old unsafe contract** where any terminal status (`status: "done"`) unconditionally reaped a detached worktree even if its commit was never pushed to any remote.
- Under the new guard contract introduced in #6997 (fixing #6996), unpushed commits must never be reaped. Un-mocked calls to [`_is_head_reachable_from_remote`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6996-reaper-guard/scripts/orchestration/reap_worktrees.py#L565) in synthetic non-git test paths evaluated to `False` (unpushed) and correctly refused to reap.
- The tests were updated to test both facets of the contract:
  1. Pushed HEAD (`_is_head_reachable_from_remote=True`): qualifies for reap with `"detached HEAD settled dispatch task-id=..."`.
  2. Unpushed HEAD (`_is_head_reachable_from_remote=False`): returns `None` (reap skipped).
